body.name: \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}\)
body.construction: \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}\) is the set of \(\theta=((p_x,f_x,q_x)_{x\in\mathcal X},\phi_1,\phi_2)\) such that \((p_x)\in\mathcal P_{n,\alpha}\), \(f_x\in\mathscr F_n\), \(q_x\in\mathscr Q_n(f_x)\), \(\phi_j\in\Phi_{j,n}\), and, for every \(x\in\mathcal X\) and \((s,t)\in\mathcal D_n\), \(|\widehat F_{x,n}(s,t)-\widehat f_x(s+t)\phi_1(s)\phi_2(t)|\le\rho^F_{x,n}+\delta^F_n\) and \(|\widehat G_{x,n}(s,t)-\widehat q_x(s+t)\phi_1(s)\phi_2(t)|\le\rho^G_{x,n}+\delta^G_n\). All continuum inequalities in the sieve definitions are imposed exactly, so this is a sample-measurable compact subset of a fixed Euclidean coefficient-and-atom box.
